lazy_traversal_rules: Read index.json, docs/index/index.json, and this file before any repository scan.
Prefer reference-guides.json path targets over broad directory scans.
Read skills-registry.json before loading any full skill content.
Before editing, read change-impact.json and testing.json for minimal validation scope.
Treat this repository as a bundle consumed by another Symfony app unless evidence in the task says otherwise.

fallback_scan_policy.rule: Do not broad-scan before reading index files.
scan_priority: Paths listed in read_first and likely_touchpoints fields
Framework bootstrap or command files named in reference-guides.json

bundle_specific_guardrails: Stop early when the requested surface is an in-repo UI or mobile app; those workspaces are not present.
Prefer consumer-app validation commands over repo-local execution because this package is not a standalone Symfony app.

prechecks: Confirm whether the request targets this bundle or a separate consuming Symfony app.
Check entrypoints.json to see whether the requested backend surface is CLI/integration rather than an in-repo HTTP controller.
Check task-recipes.json unsupported_topics before planning endpoint or persistence work.
common_pitfalls: Assuming this repository contains a runnable GraphQL HTTP server.
Changing configuration defaults without syncing bundled sample YAML and docs.
Relying on FlexibleGraphqlExtension::process() without checking compiler-pass registration implications.
stop_conditions: Stop when the requested feature is confirmed to belong to a consuming app rather than this bundle.
Stop when the relevant bundle module and touchpoints are identified.

prechecks: Check workspaces.json for a mobile workspace before reading source files.
common_pitfalls: This repository does not contain an in-repo mobile workspace.
stop_conditions: Stop after confirming mobile workspace is Not found.

prechecks: Check workspaces.json for a UI workspace before reading source files.
common_pitfalls: This repository does not contain an in-repo UI workspace.
stop_conditions: Stop after confirming UI workspace is Not found.

prechecks: Use skills-registry.json only after confirming the requested task maps to a present module or documented consumer workflow.
Prefer narrow PHP/Symfony/GraphQL skills over generic language skills.
common_pitfalls: Loading frontend or mobile skills for a PHP bundle task.
Ignoring read_before_using references tied to the chosen skill.
stop_conditions: Stop when one or two high-applicability skills and their prerequisite references are selected.

prechecks: Distinguish code entrypoints from documentation-only consumer examples.
Check runtime-surfaces.json to understand whether the entrypoint is CLI, cache warm, or documented HTTP usage.
common_pitfalls: Treating docs/index.md controller example as in-repo executable code.
Skipping bundle extension and cache warmer entrypoints because they are not HTTP handlers.
stop_conditions: Stop when all relevant surface-specific entrypoints are enumerated for the task.

prechecks: Confirm the story targets bundle internals, documented consumer setup, or a missing surface.
Use modules.json to identify the smallest relevant module set before scanning files.
Read testing.json before planning validation.
common_pitfalls: Assuming repo-local tests or CI are available.
Changing command/config contracts without updating docs and default sample YAML.
Broad-scanning src/ before reading the high-signal references.
stop_conditions: Stop when a matching recipe and minimal touchpoint set are identified.
Stop early when the request maps to a missing UI/mobile/persistence surface.

prechecks: Compare Configuration.php defaults with bundled sample YAML and docs.
Check whether the config question concerns consumer-app paths such as schema_files or dir.
common_pitfalls: Assuming docs and config defaults are already synchronized.
Ignoring executor and schema_type branches in FlexibleGraphqlExtension.
stop_conditions: Stop when the config source of truth and all affected docs/code touchpoints are identified.

prechecks: Check whether repo-local automated tests are present before promising them.
Use change-impact.json to limit validation to affected commands/config/docs.
common_pitfalls: Assuming PHPUnit dependency implies current test files exist.
Using repo-local execution when validation actually requires a consuming Symfony app.
stop_conditions: Stop when the minimal validation scope and any missing-coverage caveats are explicit.

prechecks: Check commands.json category_index for build/lint/test gaps.
Check workflows.json to see which commands are consumer-app workflows rather than repo-local scripts.
common_pitfalls: Trying to run bin/console commands inside the bundle repo without a host Symfony app.
Assuming build, lint, or test scripts are defined in composer.json.
stop_conditions: Stop when available commands and missing local automation are both explicit.

prechecks: Determine whether the flow starts from consumer docs, CLI commands, or Symfony cache warm.
Check runtime-surfaces.json for the nearest surface rather than scanning src/ top to bottom.
common_pitfalls: Skipping the extension load() path that wires commands and cache warmer.
Confusing documented consumer HTTP flow with repo-local executable code.
stop_conditions: Stop when the relevant entrypoint chain and generated-file outputs are identified.
